body:
# What is BBRL?
**BBRL** is a Minecraft Server centred around **racing with friends** on **ice-boat tracks**. You can race **publicly** against people online, race **privately** with friends or **time-trial** tracks to try get the fastest time on the server! We also have a feature where you can **create** your own **tracks or builds** using the commands starting with ```/buildworld``` _(currently in beta)_. 

# How do I race in even larger races?
**BBRL** stands for **Builders & Boaters Racing League**, as we sometimes run large ice boat races for the main ice boat racing community to race in and have fun. These races are **not** meant to be competitive, as we edit the track while races are happening to create chaos and fun!
